name: Grassline the Striped Cat
blurb: Grassline, a deep-orange shorthair with bold black stripes, white cheeks and gold eyes, creeps low through the long grass after moths.

name: Ember the Snow-Muzzle Cat
blurb: Ember, a rust-orange cat with thick black stripes, a snow-white muzzle and white-spotted black ears, sniffs every seed-head on the path.

name: Saffron the Long-Whisker Cat
blurb: Saffron, a burnt-orange tabby with black stripes, white brows and very long white whiskers, stares down the garden sprinkler at dusk.
